name: binder-focused
cmd: set -euo pipefail; out="$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR"; git rev-parse HEAD > "$out/source.txt"; bun --version > "$out/runtime.txt"; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$out/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/binder-tsconfig.json > "$out/types.log" 2>&1; bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config core/dsl.ts core/dsl-binders.ts core/dsl-binders.test.ts core/prenex-admission.test.ts > "$out/lint.log" 2>&1; bun test core/dsl-binders.test.ts core/prenex-admission.test.ts core/quantifiers.test.ts core/dsl.test.ts core/exists.test.ts core/exists-support.test.ts core/liveness.test.ts > "$out/tests.log" 2>&1; for file in examples/*.ts; do bun -e "await import('./$file')" >> "$out/examples.log" 2>&1; done; git log -1 --format=%B > "$out/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$out/commit-message.txt" > "$out/commitlint.log" 2>&1
